10-01.ja:
flowchart TD
    A[依頼] --> B["/poteto-mode"]
    B --> C[Principlesの一覧を読む]
    C --> D{依頼の種類を判定}
    D -->|調べるだけの質問| E[Investigation]
    D -->|不具合| F[Bug fix]
    D -->|新しい振る舞い| G[Feature]
    D -->|構造だけの変更| H[Refactoring]
    D -->|測定できる遅さ| I[Perf issue]
    D -->|大きな作業、該当なし| J["/figure-it-out"]
    E --> K[検証して報告]
    F --> K
    G --> K
    H --> K
    I --> K
    J --> K
10-01.en:
flowchart TD
    A[Request] --> B["/poteto-mode"]
    B --> C[Read the list of Principles]
    C --> D{Classify the kind of request}
    D -->|Question that only needs investigation| E[Investigation]
    D -->|Bug| F[Bug fix]
    D -->|New behavior| G[Feature]
    D -->|Structure-only change| H[Refactoring]
    D -->|Measurable slowness| I[Perf issue]
    D -->|Large work, or no match| J["/figure-it-out"]
    E --> K[Verify and report]
    F --> K
    G --> K
    H --> K
    I --> K
    J --> K

flowchart TD
    A[请求] --> B["/poteto-mode"]

    C --> D{判断请求类型}
    D -->|只需调查的问题| E[Investigation]
    D -->|缺陷| F[Bug fix]
    D -->|新行为| G[Feature]
    D -->|仅改变结构| H[Refactoring]
    D -->|可测量的性能问题| I[Perf issue]
    D -->|大型工作或无匹配项| J["/figure-it-out"]
    E --> K[验证并报告]

    J --> K

22-01.ja:

    B->>S: Writes 10 + 1 = 11, overwriting A's write

23-02.ja:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as 処理A
    participant C as カウンタ
    participant B as 処理B
    Note over C: 値 = 10
    A->>C: 値を読む
    C-->>A: 10
    B->>C: 値を読む
    C-->>B: 10
    A->>C: 値がまだ10なら11にする
    Note over C: 値 = 11（成功）
    B->>C: 値がまだ10なら11にする
    C-->>B: 失敗（値はもう11）
    B->>C: 値を読み直す
    C-->>B: 11
    B->>C: 値がまだ11なら12にする
    Note over C: 値 = 12（成功）
23-02.en:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Process A
    participant C as Counter
    participant B as Process B
    Note over C: Value = 10
    A->>C: Read the value
    C-->>A: 10
    B->>C: Read the value
    C-->>B: 10
    A->>C: If the value is still 10, make it 11
    Note over C: Value = 11, success
    B->>C: If the value is still 10, make it 11
    C-->>B: Failure, the value is already 11
    B->>C: Read the value again
    C-->>B: 11
    B->>C: If the value is still 11, make it 12
    Note over C: Value = 12, success
23-02.zh-CN:
sequenceDiagram

    A->>C: 读取值
    C-->>A: 10
    B->>C: 读取值
    C-->>B: 10
    A->>C: 如果值仍为 10，就改为 11
    Note over C: 值 = 11（成功）
    B->>C: 如果值仍为 10，就改为 11
    C-->>B: 失败（值已经是 11）
    B->>C: 重新读取值
    C-->>B: 11
    B->>C: 如果值仍为 11，就改为 12
    Note over C: 值 = 12（成功）

25-02.ja:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as エージェント
    participant H as 人間
    Note over A,H: 聞いて待つ場合
    A->>H: 関数の名前を変えてもいいですか
    Note over A: 返事が来るまで、後の作業がすべて止まる
    H-->>A: いいです
    A->>A: 名前を変え、後の作業を続ける
    Note over A,H: 進めてから見せる場合
    A->>A: 名前を変え、後の作業を続ける

25-02.en:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Agent
    participant H as Human
    Note over A,H: Asking and waiting
    A->>H: May I rename the function?
    Note over A: All later work stops until the reply comes
    H-->>A: Yes
    A->>A: Renames it and continues the later work
    Note over A,H: Proceeding, then presenting
    A->>A: Renames it and continues the later work
    A->>H: I renamed it because it makes the calling code easier to read
    H-->>A: If the name does not fit, revert it
25-02.zh-CN:
sequenceDiagram

    participant H as 人

    Note over A: 收到回复前，后续工作全部暂停
    H-->>A: 可以
    A->>A: 修改名称，继续后续工作
    Note over A,H: 先推进，再展示
    A->>A: 修改名称，继续后续工作
    A->>H: 为了让调用方代码更易读，我修改了名称

30-01.ja:
flowchart TD
    A["A: 採点基準を決め、候補ごとに別の出力先を割り当てる"] --> B["B: 同じプロンプトで候補を同時に起動する"]
    B --> C1["候補1（Opus）"]
    B --> C2["候補2（GPT）"]
    B --> C3["候補3（Grok）"]
    C1 --> J["C: 判定役が採点する"]
    C2 --> J
    C3 --> J
    C1 --> R["D: 主エージェントが全候補を読んで採点する"]
    C2 --> R
    C3 --> R
    J --> P["D: 判定役の採点と比べて、土台を1つ選ぶ"]
    R --> P
    P --> E["E: ほかの候補の良い部分を、土台の設計に合わせて書き直して組み込む"]
    E --> F["F: 統合した成果物を確かめる"]
    F --> O["成果物1つと統合メモを返す"]
30-01.en:
flowchart TD
    A["A: Decide the grading criteria and assign each candidate its own output location"] --> B["B: Start the candidates at the same time with the same prompt"]
    B --> C1["Candidate 1: Opus"]
    B --> C2["Candidate 2: GPT"]
    B --> C3["Candidate 3: Grok"]
    C1 --> J["C: The judge grades"]
    C2 --> J
    C3 --> J
    C1 --> R["D: The main agent reads and grades every candidate"]
    C2 --> R
    C3 --> R
    J --> P["D: Compare with the judge's grades and pick one base"]
    R --> P
    P --> E["E: Rewrite the good parts of the other candidates to fit the base's design and fold them in"]
